statement: Seed and join retain the one lifecycle command owner created with the canonical service install catalog owner, bind that same owner and its gateway to the authoritative runtime SQL engine before external exposure, and retire the provisional engine without a second lifecycle mutation authority.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

ControlPlaneSetup creates the lifecycle command owner exactly once with its canonical ServiceInstallCatalogOwner. Seed and join retain that exact object; the authoritative SQL runtime rebinds both its SQL dispatch reference and catalog gateway to the final SQLQueryEngine. No fallback owner, second catalog owner, or direct-table lifecycle path is allowed.

The shared startup SQL handoff completes lifecycle-owner and gateway rebinding before BootstrapAPI, admin runtime, or PG-wire consumers receive the authoritative engine. The provisional engine remains a bounded early-runtime adapter and is shut down through the existing handoff path.

Both seed and join production branches retain and hand off the same command owner. A final-engine INSTALL or SHOW request reaches that retained owner and its gateway uses the final engine; missing retained ownership fails closed as command_owner_unavailable rather than constructing another owner.

Production changes are bounded to shared ControlPlaneSetup lifecycle binding, seed/join retention, and shared startup SQL-runtime handoff. Tests and one scenario runner may cover those seams. Reconciliation, runtime activation, CLI behavior, manifest/catalog semantics, new transport, and actual-state owners are excluded.

The scenario proves the final engine fails before the fix, both startup branches preserve object identity, the gateway cannot remain pinned to the provisional engine, repeated handoff is idempotent, missing ownership does not synthesize a fallback, and provisional shutdown does not detach the final binding.

Independent verification must approve the exact source patch and aggregate fingerprint and show the scenario turns red when seed retention, join retention, final-engine command binding, or final-engine gateway rebinding is removed.
